title: 第1281章 跟老子的雷法说去吧第1280章 几个脑袋
slug: 剑问九州第1286章星域虫潮
content_zh:
镇国刀硬生生劈开太徽剑宗护山大阵，一时间恐怖动静比雷声更盛，刀光倾轧之下，数座山峰崩碎坍塌，偌大宗门登时遍地哀嚎。
“轰咔！——”
滚滚黑云随雷电一齐压向太徽剑宗腹地，白泽驾驭风雨雷电，脚踏虚空，一步一步走向东栎峰出云阁。
“护山大阵被一刀劈开，怎么可能？！”
“万脊山脉不世出的妖祖吗……”
“太恐怖了，如此强敌，大帝之姿打得过吗！”
“古之大帝横推世间一切敌，即便越境一战，也不在话下！”
“毁我宗门大阵，大帝之姿，斩了这妖人！”
嘈杂之声在风雷之下疯狂叫嚣。
可有修士却觉察到不对劲。
那引来恐怖天象的“妖祖”，身上分明没有丝毫妖气！
这又是怎么回事？
莫非他并非妖物，而是人族？
可放眼整个天灵大陆，怎么会有如此年轻，却能一刀劈开大陆第一宗门护山大阵的怪物！？
难道他才是真正的大帝之姿？！
“大帝之姿，相当缩头乌龟吗？”白泽冷声说道，声音比雷霆更压迫，“且登天一战，看看你的极道帝兵能否挨住老子这一刀！”
“前辈！这其中可是有什么误会……”
一刀劈碎护山大阵，太徽剑宗宗主遍体生寒，内心痛骂大长老，可眼看那道人一副要将宗门移平的模样，不得不硬着头皮说道：“大帝之姿乃是天外……”
“你就是大长老？”白泽乜了太徽剑宗宗主一眼，袍袖一卷，一巴掌拍了过去，气劲轰鸣间，那天灵大陆第一宗门掌教被直愣愣打下中天，身形狠狠砸向主峰大殿。
“碰！”

太徽剑宗主峰大殿登时被那道身影砸出一个巨大窟窿。
“宗主！”
“嘶，怎么可能，宗主被他……不，天灵大陆最强宗门……他到底是何方神圣！？”
太徽剑宗宗主吐血不止，身形狼狈地从大殿废墟中爬起，却又踉跄倒地。
“不是大长老挡什么路？”白泽说道，“一个能打的都没有，叫大帝来！”
太徽剑宗炸了。
天灵大陆最强宗门宗主被一巴掌打得倒地不起！
“都怪大长老，说什么域外天人大帝之姿！我看他分明就是缩头乌龟，什么横推世间一切敌，大帝之姿在哪？还不出去一战！”
“狗屁大帝之姿！”
“大长老呢，他惹的祸端，他跑到哪里去了？！”
出云阁，绮罗眼睁睁看着宗主被一巴掌抽得砸落主峰大殿，不知死活，内心恐惧至极。
她下意识看向玄觞，大帝之姿脸色来回变幻，面目狰狞，竟是在浑身发抖！
这位太徽剑宗的天之骄女心里咯噔一下。
难不成这一切，其实都是大长老编织的骗局？哪里有什么大帝之姿，只是看他恐惧的模样，怎么可能横推世间一切敌！？
正所谓人不为己天诛地灭。
如此懦夫，怎配自己委身！
绮罗一咬牙，二话不说，飞身跑出出云阁！
当此时，到处躲藏的大长老被揪了出来。
“搞什么，搞什么？！成何体统，你们是要反天了！”
content_en:
The Zhenguo Sword forcefully split open the Taihui Sword Sect's mountain-protecting formation. For a moment, the terrifying movement was louder than the thunder. Under the sword's light, several mountain peaks shattered and collapsed, and the huge sect was wailing all over the place.
"Boom!——"
Rolling black clouds followed the thunder and lightning toward the hinterland of the Taihui Sword Sect. Bai Ze rode the wind, rain, thunder and lightning, stepping on the void, and walked step by step towards the Chuyun Pavilion at Dongqiao Peak.
"How is it possible that the mountain-protecting formation was split open with a single knife?!"
"Is there an unparalleled demon ancestor from the Ten Thousand Ridges Mountains..."
"It's too terrifying. Can the Emperor's posture defeat such a powerful enemy?"
"The ancient emperor defeated all enemies in the world, even if he fought across borders, it would be no problem!"
"Destroy my sect's formation, act like a great emperor, and kill this monster!"
The noise was shouting wildly under the wind and thunder.
But some monks noticed something was wrong.
The "demon ancestor" who caused the terrifying celestial phenomena clearly had no demonic aura on him!
What's going on?
Could it be that he is not a monster, but a human being?
But looking at the entire Tianling Continent, how could there be such a young monster who could split open the continent's first sect's mountain guarding formation with one sword! ?
Could it be that he is the true emperor? !
"Isn't the posture of a great emperor quite a coward?" Bai Ze said coldly, his voice more oppressive than thunder, "Let's go to the sky and fight, and see if your Ji Dao Emperor soldiers can withstand my sword!"
"Senior! There is some misunderstanding..."
The Taihui Sword Sect's leader felt chills all over his body after smashing the mountain-protecting formation with one strike. He scolded the great elder in his heart. But seeing that the Taoist looked like he was about to move the sect to the ground, he had no choice but to bite the bullet and said: "The emperor's appearance is beyond the sky..."
"Are you the Great Elder?" Bai Ze glanced at the leader of the Taihui Sword Sect, rolled up his robe sleeves, and slapped him with a slap. With a roar of energy, the leader of the first sect in the Tianling Continent was knocked straight down to the sky, and his body was slammed into the main peak hall.
"Touch!"
The main hall of Taihui Sword Sect's main peak was immediately smashed into a huge hole by that figure.
"Sect Master!"
"Hiss, how is it possible? The sect leader is... no, the strongest sect in Tianling Continent... who is he?"
The leader of the Taihui Sword Sect vomited blood and climbed up from the ruins of the hall in a panic, only to stumble and fall to the ground.
"If it's not the Great Elder, why is it blocking the way?" Bai Ze said, "There's no one who can fight. Call the Great Emperor!"
Taihui Sword Sect exploded.
The leader of the strongest sect in Tianling Continent was slapped and fell to the ground!
"It's all the fault of the Great Elder for talking about the appearance of a great emperor from outside the realm! I think he is clearly a coward. He is trying to overthrow all enemies in the world. Where is the appearance of an emperor? Why don't you go out and fight!"
"What a bullshit emperor!"
"Where's the Great Elder? He caused the trouble. Where did he go?!"
In Izumo Pavilion, Qiluo watched helplessly as the sect master was slapped and knocked down into the main hall. He didn't know whether to live or die, and was extremely frightened in his heart.
She subconsciously looked at Xuan Zhang. The emperor's face changed back and forth, his face was ferocious, and he was actually trembling all over!
This proud daughter of Taihui Sword Sect felt her heart skip a beat.
Is it possible that all of this is actually a scam spun by the Great Elder? There is no sign of a great emperor, just look at his fearful look, how could he overwhelm all enemies in the world! ?
As the saying goes, if people don't take care of themselves, they will be destroyed by heaven and earth.
How can such a coward be worthy of committing himself!
Kirara gritted his teeth and ran out of Izumo Pavilion without saying a word!
At this time, the great elder who was hiding everywhere was found out.
"What are you doing, what are you doing?! How dignified are you? You are going to rebel!"
